summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated hardcoded network destination in message-send path
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js at lines 425 and 436 constructs a network destination via String.fromCharCode(...) that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is hidden as a decimal char-code array rather than appearing as a plain string, and is embedded in the core WhatsApp message-send code path of what is presented as a Baileys-style library. Obfuscated reconstruction of an author-controlled host inside a messaging library's send path is the shape used to covertly relay caller session data or messages to a third-party endpoint the caller did not configure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
